responsibility: Implements the in-place Rust AST macro expansion traversal. This file walks crates, items, statements, expressions, types, and associated-item containers; distinguishes builtin attributes from user procedural attributes; expands builtin derives and procedural derive macros; replaces attribute and bang macro invocations with AST::Fragment results via MacroExpander; manages expansion contexts for items, traits, impls, blocks, and extern blocks; and normalizes expanded children so later parsing and analysis see a macro-expanded AST.
same_name_distinction: Implements the macro-expansion traversal itself, including attribute handling, derive expansion, fragment replacement, and context management while walking the AST. Unlike the paired header, this .cc contains the operational expansion logic rather than just the ExpandVisitor API and templates.
